استهلكتم (form X)
# اِسْتَهْلَكْتُمْ (istahlaktum) /is.tah.lak.tum/: second-person masculine plural past active of اِسْتَهْلَكَ (istahlaka)
# اُسْتُهْلِكْتُمْ (ustuhliktum) /us.tuh.lik.tum/: second-person masculine plural past passive of اِسْتَهْلَكَ (istahlaka)
